notes.title: Patch 1.9.6 (Toasty Update)
notes.content: [p]New patch for Under Rooms demo[/p][list][*][p]The crafting system has been temporarily removed.[/p][/*][*][p]All maps have been rebuilt.[/p][/*][*][p]More interaction with the environment has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Several bugs from previous versions have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The resolution has been set to 1280x720 as default.[/p][/*][*][p]The lighting system has been simplified.[/p][/*][*][p]And much more...[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks Toasty Time![/p]
